run_record_video: run mjwarp-record to record a GIF video of a MuJoCo simulation from an MJCF model file
run_record_depth: run mjwarp-record with warp rendering to record a depth channel video of a MuJoCo simulation
run_record_rgb: run mjwarp-record with warp rendering to record an RGB channel video of a MuJoCo simulation
run_record_orbit: run mjwarp-record with python rendering to record a video with a symmetric orbiting camera
run_record_custom: run mjwarp-record with custom fps, quality, and camera distance settings for a MuJoCo simulation
